widgets_values:
Create one photorealistic premium baby sleepwear ecommerce photograph, not a contact sheet. Use a quiet Korean-minimal home catalogue style with warm white, pale wood, soft daylight, restrained props, accurate color, realistic skin and fabric, and a clean commercial finish. Keep the whole six-image set visually consistent in lighting, color treatment, camera quality, and the child's identity. Never add text, price labels, watermarks, borders, brand marks, extra garments, extra children, adult styling, makeup, unsafe objects, or invented decoration.
INPUT BOARD: a 2-column by 2-row reference board. Top-left is the sleepwear front, top-right is the sleepwear back, bottom-left is the fabric macro, and bottom-right is the real child model. The three product panels are the sole source of truth for the sleepwear. Preserve the exact garment category, silhouette, proportions, color, print, logo, neckline, sleeves, seams, closures, pockets, cuffs, waistband, hem, and material. The bottom-right panel is the sole identity source. Preserve the same real child's facial structure, eyes, nose, mouth, skin tone, hair, apparent age, and body proportions. Ignore the child's original clothes and background, and dress the child in the exact referenced sleepwear. Do not reproduce the board layout in the output and do not redesign the sleepwear.
OUTPUT INSTRUCTION: Create one product-only front-view hero image on a seamless warm-white to light-gray studio background. Use a hollow invisible child-size mannequin so the sleepwear has realistic volume. Centered, symmetrical, no person, no hanger, no props, subtle contact shadow, square composition. Ignore the child panel for this product-only shot.

SCENE PRESET OR CUSTOM INPUT: warm_white_bedroom
ACTION PRESET OR CUSTOM INPUT: 18-month toddler standing with feet slightly wide, one hand lightly touching a low safe bed edge for balance

Create one photorealistic premium baby sleepwear ecommerce photograph, not a contact sheet. Use a quiet Korean-minimal home catalogue style with warm white, pale wood, soft daylight, restrained props, accurate color, realistic skin and fabric, and a clean commercial finish. Keep the whole six-image set visually consistent in lighting, color treatment, camera quality, and the child's identity. Never add text, price labels, watermarks, borders, brand marks, extra garments, extra children, adult styling, makeup, unsafe objects, or invented decoration.
INPUT BOARD: a 2-column by 2-row reference board. Top-left is the sleepwear front, top-right is the sleepwear back, bottom-left is the fabric macro, and bottom-right is the real child model. The three product panels are the sole source of truth for the sleepwear. Preserve the exact garment category, silhouette, proportions, color, print, logo, neckline, sleeves, seams, closures, pockets, cuffs, waistband, hem, and material. The bottom-right panel is the sole identity source. Preserve the same real child's facial structure, eyes, nose, mouth, skin tone, hair, apparent age, and body proportions. Ignore the child's original clothes and background, and dress the child in the exact referenced sleepwear. Do not reproduce the board layout in the output and do not redesign the sleepwear.
AGE LOCK: preserve the exact same 18-month-old toddler from the child reference and never make her older or younger. Keep her 80-84 cm scale, 3.5-head body ratio, large head, almost no neck, round belly, short chubby limbs, tiny hands and feet, and wide toddler stance in every model image. Avoid preschooler proportions, long legs or neck, slim body, mature face, confident fashion pose or older-child movement. Use only age-appropriate, natural and physically safe movement: sitting, supported standing, relaxed wide-stance standing, slow toddling or simple board-book play. If the requested action is unsafe or developmentally unsuitable for the referenced child, automatically use the closest safe age-appropriate alternative. Keep the full sleepwear visible and unobstructed, with hands and props away from important prints, neckline, cuffs and waistband. Natural anatomy, correct hands and feet.
CONTROL RULE: edit only the two control lines at the top when changing a shot. A value may be a preset code below or a literal Chinese/English description; literal custom text overrides the preset dictionary. HOME SCENE PRESETS: warm_white_bedroom = 明亮暖白儿童卧室、浅木家具、柔和晨光; cozy_bedroom = 温暖卧室、素色床品、低饱和软装; living_room_play_area = 简洁客厅游戏区、地毯和少量木质玩具; window_reading_corner = 窗边阅读角、纱帘和软垫; nursery_floor_mat = 婴儿房地垫区、干净安全、无杂物; bedside_morning = 清晨床边、暖白床品、自然侧光. ACTION PRESETS: front_age_appropriate = 正面完整展示，按年龄选择扶坐或自然站立; sitting_on_rug = 坐在地毯上，双手不挡衣服; reading_picture_book = 自然翻阅绘本，书本低于胸口; crawling_forward = 宝宝安全向前爬行; standing_relaxed = 自然站立，双臂放松; walking_side = 轻缓侧向走动; stretching_after_waking = 起床后轻柔伸展; bedside_sitting = 安全坐在床边或低矮软垫上.
OUTPUT INSTRUCTION: A full-body front-facing identity anchor of the same real child, with the face clearly visible, natural friendly expression, camera near the child's eye level, and the complete sleepwear clearly shown.
